title: Reading: Bibó István on Guilt and Responsibility
goal: I can report what a text says about guilt and responsibility (*A szöveg szerint …*).
I can say that only an individual can be guilty, but a society can take responsibility.
I can use the words of reckoning with the past (*kollektív bűnösség*, *felelősségvállalás*).
